description: Parking Occupancy is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) operates a portfolio of several City-owned off-street parking facilities. This data is the utilization data from these assets, which is a critical input for evidence-based decision-making to support real estate planning, transportation management, economic development, and smart city initiatives. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are lots. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XML. The portal shows 2026-04-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
